newsitem.title: USA: NYC council says raises Nov revenue forecast.
newsitem.headline: NYC council says raises Nov revenue forecast.

text.p: The New York City city council said Wednesday its November tax revenue forecast was $134 million higher than recently revised forecasts from the Office of Management and Budget.
The Nov 1998 forecast was $232 million higher than OMB predictions.
The improved outlook was partly the result of higher than expected revenues from Wall Street securities firms, the city council said in a statement.
But City Council Chairman Herbert Berman warned that "significant risks remain in the current budget and these new revenues must address those risks before we can discuss restorations."
